services.name: Balloon Rides
services.desc: At Sky’s The Limit we are proud of our fleet of state of the art, impeccably maintained European style balloons. Each one is inspected daily by our pilots and crew and every 100 hours of flying by a FAA certified inspection facility to make sure that the balloons are always in prime condition. Select a Flight: Del Mar Coastal Champagne Evening Santa Barbara Morning Temecula Champagne

blurb: Guests take hot air balloon rides lasting about an hour, covering approximately six miles depending on wind conditions. The entire experience takes about four hours from meeting to return. Flights operate year-round, typically in early mornings or late afternoons for stable air conditions.
extraNote: Reservations require 100% payment to confirm · Cancellation requires 48 hours notice prior to flight day; 7 days for private or groups of 6+ · If no trip insurance, 72 hours written notice required to cancel · With trip insurance, cancel up to 8 hours before for flight credit, reschedule within 1 year · Groups 6-13 require 10 days written notice to cancel or adjust · Groups 14+ require 20 days written notice to cancel or reschedule · Private flights require 14 days written notice to cancel · Santa Barbara location meeting point: Los Olivos Grocery, 2621 Hwy 154, Santa Ynez, CA 93460. Park on the west side of the building. · Year-round
